features.heroDescription: PrivateChat aims to offer you a communication space where privacy, control over your conversations, and simplicity are at the heart of the experience.

private.title: Private conversations
private.description: A space designed for communicating with your contacts, with privacy at the heart of the project.

groups.title: Group chats
groups.description: Bring your contacts together in group conversations to communicate and share in one place.

ephemeral.title: Ephemeral messages
ephemeral.description: The project plans to delete messages after they have been read or after a duration chosen by the user.

files.title: File sharing
files.description: The goal is to make it easy to share documents, images, and other files in an environment that respects privacy.

privacy.title: Respect for personal data
privacy.description: Limit the data collected, never sell it to advertisers, and prioritize privacy-respecting practices.

windows.title: Windows application
windows.description: A dedicated desktop application is planned to let you use PrivateChat on a Windows computer.

features.closingTitle: Privacy should be a choice, not a compromise.
features.closingDescription: Discover the security principles guiding the design of PrivateChat.
